---
title: "Walkthrough"
subtitle: "Eight short scripts that take the package apart one layer at a time, on synthetic data with a known answer."
---

This section runs `wdm` one layer at a time on synthetic data with a known answer: the model alone, a synthetic record with a hidden truth, the two estimation phases, the tape measure, the backtest, and the controller, first losing and then holding. Everything uses the package's Python API, so it also serves as a guide to using `wdm` as a library. The theory behind each layer is in [The model](../theory/model.md), [Estimation](../theory/estimation.md) and [Control](../theory/control.md).

**How to use it.** From `weight-dynamics/code`, after [Getting started](../getting-started.md):

```bash
cd weight-dynamics/code && uv run python walkthrough/01_model.py
```

- Each page gives the command, the script (folded), the output it printed on 2026-10-28, what to notice in it, the modules and functions it uses (under `wdm`, documented in the [API reference](../reference/index.qmd)), and a "Try this" exercise.
- Seeds are fixed, so your numbers should match to the digits shown; another JAX or SciPy version can change the last digits of the optimizer-driven results (steps 3 to 8).
- Steps 2 to 8 share one subject and one episode: a 40-year-old man, 175 cm, starting at 100 kg and 30 % body fat, eating about 80 % of his maintenance for 120 days, with a metabolism set deliberately away from the prior (the values `wdm demo` and the tests use). Each script rebuilds the episode from the same seed, so each runs on its own.

## The steps

| Step | What it shows | Script | CLI equivalent | Runtime |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [1. The model](01-model.md) | A diet simulated at the prior: the early water drop, slower tissue loss, adaptation | `01_model.py` | none | 1.6 s |
| [2. Synthetic data](02-synthetic.md) | Weigh-ins with noise, food logs, weekly waist readings, and the hidden truth | `02_synthetic.py` | [`wdm demo`](../commands.md#wdm-demo) | 15 s |
| [3. Phase 1: the scale's noise](03-phase1.md) | Reading noise, steady-state gain and effective window, against the true noise | `03_phase1.py` | [`wdm fit-noise`](../commands.md#wdm-fit-noise) | 31 s |
| [4. Phase 2: state and metabolism](04-phase2.md) | The joint fit: parameter recovery against the truth, what "shift" means, maintenance | `04_phase2.py` | [`wdm filter`](../commands.md#wdm-filter) | 20 s |
| [5. The waist tape](05-waist.md) | The same fit with and without waist readings: the fat-mass interval and bias | `05_waist.py` | [`wdm filter`](../commands.md#wdm-filter) | 22 s |
| [6. The backtest](06-backtest.md) | 1- and 7-day forecasts against persistence, and their calibration | `06_backtest.py` | [`wdm backtest`](../commands.md#wdm-backtest) | 21 s |
| [7. Planning](07-plan.md) | Deadline and sustainable plans, the constraint check, an impossible deadline | `07_plan.py` | [`wdm plan`](../commands.md#wdm-plan) | 27 s |
| [8. Maintain](08-maintain.md) | Holding today's tissue and a weight 3 lb below: intake near maintenance, a gentle correction | `08_maintain.py` | [`wdm plan --mode maintain`](../commands.md#wdm-plan) | 25 s |

Runtimes are wall-clock on a 20-thread desktop CPU, including Python and JAX start-up; most of each is generating the synthetic episode, one day at a time in Python.
